stockfish.js 19.0.1
===================

ChessFEN vendors the pinned lite single-threaded browser engine from the
stockfish.js project, a WebAssembly build of Stockfish 19.

Upstream project:
https://github.com/nmrugg/stockfish.js

Release:
https://github.com/nmrugg/stockfish.js/releases/tag/v19.0.1

Distribution:
npm package stockfish@19.0.1, tarball shasum
c557a1b9f075a67f38e01332c6db7472d8df744e

Vendored on 2026-11-25:

ccb130d7ff29408531c47d859a49f91d59d4f482d05a53eb1a3231a4f624c91a  stockfish-19-lite-single.js
ee4f115bdb2d32cadf96cada104a05b5ec257d7ad6f57582190b49bc71f096de  stockfish-19-lite-single.wasm
0b383d5a63da644f628d99c33976ea6487ed89aaa59f0b3257992deac1171e6b  Copying.txt

The engine is licensed under GPL-3.0. The upstream license text is included
in Copying.txt. Corresponding engine source is available from the upstream
project and the official Stockfish repository:
https://github.com/official-stockfish/Stockfish

Do not replace these files with an unpinned remote download at runtime.
